About AAYWA

An African organization growing women leaders through agribusiness.

We believe young African women are not simply part of agriculture — they can shape its future.

Who we are

Women-led. Africa-rooted. Enterprise-focused.

AAYWA is an African NGO empowering young women to move beyond subsistence farming into profitable, sustainable and resilient agribusiness — as entrepreneurs, innovators and decision-makers.

Sisterhood · Leadership · Growth
About AAYWA

Where women grow, communities flourish.

AAYWA is an African NGO empowering young women to move beyond subsistence farming into profitable, sustainable agribusiness — giving them ownership, knowledge, leadership and a place in the global economy.

Vision

Transforming the lives of young African women from subsistence farming to sustainable agribusiness.

Mission

Empowering young African women to build profitable, sustainable agribusinesses through training, finance, innovation, global markets and ethical value chains — while developing leaders who create lasting change.

Discover AAYWASee how we work
“

We do not measure transformation by training alone. We follow the journey from opportunity to enterprise, and from enterprise to leadership.

A belief that shapes AAYWA
Explore our impact story

Our values

The principles behind every programme, partnership and decision.

Eight values guide how AAYWA shows up — with the women we serve, the partners we work with and the change we pursue.

Sisterhood

We rise through shared growth, solidarity and collective success.

Leadership

We equip women to lead boldly and influence change.

Indigenous Innovation

We honour African knowledge and combine it with modern solutions.

Sustainability

We protect natural resources while building resilient livelihoods.

Empowerment

We build confidence, ownership and economic independence.

Advocacy

We amplify young women's voices and champion equitable opportunity.

Partnerships

We believe lasting impact grows through strong ecosystems.

Well-being

We connect agriculture with nutrition, wellness and thriving communities.
